checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan v0.8: recover event scripts from traces and slice machines to the transitions a script exercised

impact_assessment.why: Debugging a failing golden trace should not require hand-copying events or manually deleting unrelated model parts.
impact_assessment.benefits: Round-trip trace tooling and a minimal replayable model for isolating a bug; both pure and deterministic.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: trace parser must reject malformed input with line numbers; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a slice must never silently drop a property.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate the trace header and step shape, derive slices only from recorded transition indices, and report every dropped property explicitly.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan v0.9: explicit terminal states so slices verify cleanly without weakening dead-end detection

impact_assessment.why: A deliberate end state and an accidental sink must be distinguishable; v0.8 exposed the cost of conflating them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Slices replay through every CLI command, and models can document intentional completion points.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: model and canonical form gain a declaration; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: verify must skip only declared terminals.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require terminals to name declared states, keep the dead-end finding for all others, and test both the accepted and rejected cases.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan v0.10: explain stuck events with actual guard values and list reachable configurations with shortest paths

impact_assessment.why: A stuck event currently reports only the symptom; evaluating guards against the replayed environment gives the cause, and a reachable map shows the explored state space.
impact_assessment.benefits: Faster model debugging and an inspectable view of exploration, both derived from the single pure transition selector.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two versioned output formats; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: replay of the prefix must be exact or the explanation is misleading.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive the environment by replaying the prefix, reuse choose_transition, and test both enabled and disabled guard cases with determinism checks.
